title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode13 I Refuse to Run Away!

meta.Episode: Episode13 — I Refuse to Run Away!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, I know you've been worried.
I'm sorry for not returning your messages.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Forget about that! What happened to your hair?!
And your glasses, too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. So you went to see Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. And I made a decision.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After what Shinonome said yesterday, I realized that he was right. I wasn't taking this as seriously as all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then I remembered what it felt like when we sang together here. It made me realize I want to put on an event with you that'll make others feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I still have a lot to learn...but I still want to work toward that goal together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I knew I was right about you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're the best singing partner I could ask for, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright! Let's start practicing again and try another event! We'll teach those BAD DOGS a lesson!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then one day, we'll put on an event that'll surpass RAD WEEKEND together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hello? Oh, looks like Ken is out again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Speak of the devil. Nice timing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What gives? Is that the kind of look you always give your customers?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Are you the same shrimp from yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You still hanging around here? I though I made myself clear. This isn't the place for some half-hearted—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Where are you guys singing next? I was just thinking we should crash your event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you even realize what you're saying right now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's nothing I hate more than those with weak resolve. If you're really planning on performing at the same event as us again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We will crush you once and for all.
No tricks this time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I may not know much about RAD WEEKEND or understand the feelings of those that sang there, but even so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to organize a great event with An that will give everyone the best experience of their lives!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I won't run away anymore!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We're singing at Mossy Stone.
There should still be some slots open.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great. Then that's where we'll do this.
Fair and square, this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's your funeral.
Let's get out of here, Toya. No reason to stick around if Ken isn't here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you two really serious about holding an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You lot sure have plenty of energy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah! D-Dad, were you listening to all of that?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
It's kind of hard not to when you're being so loud.
I could hear you all the way in the back.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, the new haircut looks great.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I like that look in your eyes, too.
You're finally starting to look a bit more like An and Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's that supposed to mean, Dad?
How can you compare me to Akito?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: No need to get so defensive. If I have to put it into words, he looks like he has some fight in him. Like he has something to lose.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You'll understand soon enough.
All right, time to get ready for tonight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A jerk like Akito has something to lose?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Getting lip from a shrimp like that...
I bet Shiraishi told her exactly what to say.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're the ones who are going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, and this time we'll make sure they know it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong? You feeling all right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Let's start thinking about our next set list, then.
We'll crush them for sure this time.
